tools.name: search_sessions
tools.description: Search vetted, published coding-agent sessions on a4sx (reviewed marketplace listings), or your own saved sessions with scope=library. Returns ids to use with the other tools.

tools.name: get_session_summary
tools.description: Describe one session before using it: what it did, outline, price, and whether you already have access. source=marketplace (default) or library.

tools.name: acquire_session
tools.description: Add a marketplace session you are entitled to (free, bought, or granted) to your private library. Never buys anything: for a paid listing it returns status=payment_required with the price and the listing URL.

tools.name: fetch_session_context
tools.description: Load a session from your library (saved, or added with acquire_session) as starting context for this conversation, sized to max_tokens.

tools.name: publish_session
tools.description: Save a session transcript (JSONL) to your private a4sx library. The server scrubs token-shaped secrets before storing. Private: it is never listed publicly by this tool.

tools.name: request_purchase
tools.description: Start buying a paid marketplace listing for the account holder to confirm. Nothing is charged and you never pay: it returns a verify_url and a user_code to give to the account holder, who checks the code, confirms and pays. Then poll get_purchase_request.

tools.name: get_purchase_request
tools.description: Status of a purchase you requested: pending, completed (with acquired_copy_id to load with fetch_session_context), declined or expired.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_session_summary" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Describe one session before using it: what it did, outline, price, and whether you already have access. source=marketplace (default) or library.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "publish_session" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
